title: SCRIPT BtrExec
features:
This is the executor, but you can stop the executed script. For example, the script is laggy and you need to stop it, but you don't want to rejoin the game.

THIS IS SCRIPT!!!

For testing you can try this:
while wait() do
print('SKID')
end

The stop button should stop the script
script:
local Executor = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
local UIGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
local Code = Instance.new("TextBox")
local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
local UICorner_2 = Instance.new("UICorner")
local Exec = Instance.new("TextButton")
local UICorner_3 = Instance.new("UICorner")
local stop = Instance.new("TextButton")
local UICorner_4 = Instance.new("UICorner")

Executor.Name = "Executor"
Executor.Parent = game.CoreGui.RobloxGui
Executor.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

Frame.Parent = Executor
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Frame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
Frame.Active = true
Frame.Draggable = true
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -277, 0.5, -184)
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0.287237287, 0, 0.299999982, 0)

UIGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new{ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, Color3.fromRGB(65, 65, 65)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0))}
UIGradient.Rotation = 0
UIGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new{NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.15), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.15)}
UIGradient.Parent = Frame

Code.Name = "Code"
Code.Parent = Frame
Code.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Code.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
Code.BorderSizePixel = 0
Code.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.739295781, 0)
Code.ClearTextOnFocus = false
Code.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
Code.MultiLine = true
Code.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
Code.Text = ""
Code.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
Code.TextSize = 14
Code.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
Code.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top

UICorner.Parent = Code

UICorner_2.Parent = Frame

Exec.Name = "Exec"
Exec.Parent = Frame
Exec.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Exec.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
Exec.BorderSizePixel = 0
Exec.Position = UDim2.new(8.32392857e-08, 0, 0.822207928, 0)
Exec.Size = UDim2.new(0.268563151, 0, 0.170433909, 0)
Exec.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
Exec.Text = "Execute"
Exec.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
Exec.TextScaled = true
Exec.TextSize = 14
Exec.TextWrapped = true

UICorner_3.Parent = Exec

stop.Name = "stop"
stop.Parent = Frame
stop.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
stop.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
stop.BorderSizePixel = 0
stop.Position = UDim2.new(0.728265107, 0, 0.82762593, 0)
stop.Size = UDim2.new(0.271290749, 0, 0.170433909, 0)
stop.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
stop.Text = "Stop script"
stop.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
stop.TextScaled = true
stop.TextSize = 14
stop.TextWrapped = true

UICorner_4.Parent = stop

local co

Exec.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() 
	co = coroutine.create(loadstring(Code.Text))
	coroutine.resume(co)
end)

stop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() 
	if co then
		coroutine.close(co)
	end
end)
